nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=20 beats='Miri arrives at the quiet school for holiday hen duty, carrying the care list and the coop key from Ms Green'>>

<<FILL role=setup words=50 beats='Miri fills the water dish and counts Pepper and Dot, but tiny gray Pip is missing; she closes the yard gate, notices a pale feather near the coop, and remembers Pip was present yesterday; establish the coop, garden, shed, and caretaker office as safe places Miri can search first'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='Miri checks the latch, nesting boxes, and straw; she finds fresh mud beside a loose board and must choose whether to study it herself or ask Mr Vale about it'>>

choices.label: Ask Mr Vale about the mud

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='The loose board has a Pip-sized gap beneath it, and three corn kernels lead toward the potting bench; a second pale feather lies near the playground hedge, but a robin is hopping there; Miri must choose between the solid trail beside the coop and the more distant feather'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='The kernels end beneath the potting bench, where Miri hears a soft cluck behind an overturned seed tray; she can move the tray slowly or call Mr Vale before touching it'>>

choices.label: Call Mr Vale to the bench

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Miri kneels and finds Pip tucked safely between the tray and a flowerpot, dusty but calm and unhurt'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Miri returns Pip to Pepper and Dot, gives her water, and asks Mr Vale to secure the loose board; she records every clue on Ms Green care list and completes the morning count'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='At the hedge, Miri discovers the pale feather belongs to a playground shuttlecock torn open by the wind; she can return to the coop or inspect the stronger corn trail'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='At the potting bench, Mr Vale gently lifts the light seed tray and finds Pip hiding beside a flowerpot and scattered corn'>>

choices.label: Tell Mr Vale about the clues

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip is safe, but Miri wishes she had checked the stronger trail first; she writes that feathers can belong to other things and promises to compare clues before rushing away'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='Miri finds tiny three-toed prints in the bean bed and a pale feather pointing back toward the coop; she chooses which garden sign to study first'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='The prints circle a low lavender shelf where straw sticks out, while the scratched soil continues toward the garden shed; Miri hears a faint scrape from both directions as wind stirs the leaves, so she chooses whether to inspect the hidden straw or follow the clearer footprints'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='Behind the lavender, Miri finds a snug nest beneath the shelf and hears Pip answer with one quiet cluck; she can look inside without touching or call Mr Vale over'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Miri sees Pip sitting proudly beside a small cream-colored egg and keeps her hands outside the sheltered nest'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Mr Vale brings the hen basket and care guide, and they move Pip only after preparing a safe place; Ms Green later praises Miri for finding the missing hen and her secret holiday egg'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='The footprints reach the half-open shed door, where Miri finds a gray feather and hears scratching; she can enter carefully or tempt Pip toward the doorway with corn'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Inside the shed, scratching comes from behind a covered crate, but a quick gray shape darts beneath the potting table; Miri remembers that Pip may hide when frightened; she must choose whether to uncover the crate without moving it or follow the moving shape'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Miri lifts one corner of the blanket, finds Pip safe behind a flowerpot, and calls Mr Vale to move the light crate while she holds the hen basket open'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip rides safely back to the coop, where Pepper and Dot greet her noisily; Miri checks her feet, blocks the loose board, and finishes every job on the holiday care list'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='The gray shape is a gardening glove pushed by the breeze; Miri waits, scatters corn, and watches Pip step calmly from behind the crate toward the open basket'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip enters the basket for corn, and Miri carries her home without a chase; the search ends quietly, and Miri notes that patience helped a hidden hen feel safe enough to appear'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='Miri tells caretaker Mr Vale that Pip is missing; he praises her for shutting the gate, then offers either his spoken clues or the written caretaker log'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Mr Vale lends Miri a tub of corn and recalls seeing something small near the rain barrels; children in the community garden point toward their tool shelter, while the caretaker log mentions scratching near a downpipe; Miri chooses which clue to check first'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='Behind the barrels, Miri finds damp hen prints near the downpipe; she can wait with a short corn trail or check the written log before approaching'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Pip emerges from beside the downpipe, pecking each kernel while Miri blocks the narrow gap with her basket'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip follows the final kernels into the basket and returns safely to the coop; Miri and Mr Vale cover the downpipe gap and add the useful corn trick to Ms Green care list'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='The young gardeners say a tiny gray hen slipped into their tool shelter before they closed the service gate'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Staying on her side of the fence, Miri guides the children as they lay corn from the shelter to the gate'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip trots through the service gate and into Miri waiting basket; everyone cheers, and Miri thanks the young gardeners by promising vegetables from the school garden after the holiday'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=20 beats='In Mr Vale office, Miri reads about scratching near the downpipe and finds a muddy footprint; she can follow the exact print or try the log suggested corn trick'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Miri follows the muddy print to the downpipe, finds Pip tucked behind a bucket, and uses the caretaker log to check that the narrow space is safe to approach'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=30 beats='Pip follows Miri corn into the basket and returns to Pepper and Dot; Miri circles the useful note in Mr Vale log and adds the downpipe gap to the school repair list'>>
